body_html:
#smallpoems

Strawberry moon
    rises over
Dawn's Land
  a rekindling
of Sacred
   Fire

Wabanaki Council
   rises over Dawn's Land
born to task
   lighting spirits in
Four Directions
   calling All to the
Grandmother's
   Declaration
Affirming the
Three Sisters hanging
over our summer
sun
Wingspread protections
cast moonlit
shadows on decimated peoples

  Now recognized

Like the strawberry moon
Spirit of the Grandmother rises
Living memories,
  more than forgotten
